skill.displayName: 商机雷达-比招标更早发现机会

llm.summary: This skill is mainly a business-opportunity scanner, but it also asks the agent to create and persist an account using a hashed device identifier and later generate recharge/login links, so it should go through Review before installation.

dimensions.detail: Network access to the vendor API is expected, but collecting platform, CPU architecture, and a SHA-256 hash of a MAC address for trial deduplication is more host inspection than the core opportunity-search task requires. The high-level data-out statement says only query keywords are sent, which under-discloses the auto-registration device-feature POST.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install-time execution was found. The package includes a local Python renderer that is invoked at runtime for full-mode HTML export; the script is self-contained and writes reports under the configured output directory.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation language is broad for sales and lead-generation requests, and full mode defaults to API calls plus local HTML export. The skill does require a credit-use notice before scanning and explicit consent before auto-registration.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill persists API credentials in ~/.zlbx/config.json and writes generated reports under ~/zlbx-opportunity-radar-files/. It does not create background jobs itself, but it suggests user-configured recurring scans via /loop or cron.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The opportunity-discovery API workflow is coherent, but the artifacts add zero-config account registration, device-based trial deduplication, persistent API-key storage, and recharge/login handling that are adjacent to, not strictly part of, lead discovery.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a vendor account being auto-created after consent, a hashed MAC-derived device identifier being sent for free-trial deduplication, and an API key being stored in ~/.zlbx/config.json. Pre-setting ZLBX_API_KEY should skip auto-registration. Expect local HTML reports to be written under ~/zlbx-opportunity-radar-files/ and review any recharge/login links before using them.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: Auto-registration and local API-key persistence support the advertised zero-config trial, but they expand the skill into account lifecycle management and should be reviewed because the manifest only declares an optional API-key environment variable.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The platform/architecture/MAC-hash collection is disclosed and consent-gated, but it creates a stable device-derived identifier for trial control rather than opportunity discovery.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The device-feature workflow is purpose-adjacent monetization and rate-limit infrastructure; it is not needed to search business opportunities and is not fully captured by the high-level data-out disclosure.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The quota-exhaustion flow generates an auto-login SID and presents a recharge/binding link. It does not perform payment automatically, but it moves into account/session handling beyond the core scanner.
[SDI-2] expected: The HTML report export is consistent with the promised shareable opportunity list. The renderer escapes report fields and writes a sanitized filename, so this is a runtime side-effect note rather than malicious behavior.
[SDI-2] expected: Returning an absolute local report path is disclosed in the skill and is needed for the user to open the generated file, though it mildly exposes host path structure.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The trigger criteria cover broad lead-generation and market-opportunity language, which can cause third-party API use and credit consumption for ambiguous requests. The pre-scan credit notice partially mitigates this.
[SQP-2] expected: Default report export matches the skill's shareable-report promise, but local file persistence happens by default in full mode rather than only after a separate export request.
[E1] unexpected: The auto-registration instructions send device features to ai.zhiliaobiaoxun.com. This is disclosed in the detailed registration flow and consent prompt, but it conflicts with the broader statement that only query keywords are sent externally.
